$comment: Hand-maintained input to sbom/generate.py. Not a BOM: only the parts of one that cannot be derived from the source tree. See sbom/README.md.

contact.name: VoteCheck security contact — GitHub private vulnerability reporting at https://github.com/mashi89/VoteCheck/security/advisories/new

component.description: Edustajavahti (edustajavahti.fi): server-rendered site and /api/v1 JSON API over a local SQLite mirror of api.eduskunta.fi. Shipped as the container image built from VoteCheckWeb/Dockerfile.

externalReferences.comment: Single point of contact for reporting vulnerabilities in this product.

properties.name: votecheck:cra:requirement
properties.value: Annex I, Part II, point (1): a software bill of materials in a commonly used and machine-readable format, covering at the very least the top-level dependencies of the product

properties.name: votecheck:cra:dependencyCoverage
properties.value: complete transitive closure, not only top-level dependencies

properties.name: votecheck:cra:scope
properties.value: The deployed VoteCheckWeb container image. The Avalonia desktop app (WPFGUI) and the test projects are separate and not covered.

properties.name: votecheck:sbom:reproducible
properties.value: Regenerating from the same source tree reproduces this document byte for byte, apart from metadata.timestamp.

licenseOverrides.$comment: NuGet packages old enough to carry a deprecated licenseUrl instead of an SPDX expression. The tool can only report 'Unknown - See URL' for these; each id below was read off the licence file the package points at, which is recorded as the url.
